title: What the pipeline toolchain reports about itself
summary: Asks each tool in this domain's environment for its version and writes them out. It computes nothing scientific. It exists so that an environment can be proven to activate on a machine before anything expensive is submitted into it.

third_party.name: biobakery_workflows
third_party.note: The versions this reports are the answer, so they are not asserted here.

environment.provenance: No image. A conda environment pinned by the lockfile above.

activation.note: The pipeline's conda environment. Where conda itself lives is a property of the machine and comes from the site.

outputs.name: versions
outputs.description: One line per tool, as that tool reports itself.

determinism.note: Reads version strings. Nothing is sampled.

resources.memory_hint: Four processes that print a line each.

notes: Written to prove conda activation end to end on a real machine without needing study data.
